description:
As the people who rely on live model choice
  I want each promise to be checked against an input a wrong build would get wrong
  So that a pass means the behaviour is real and the checks can tell right from wrong

elements.name: Clearing an override while the default's provider is disabled previews the fallback

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the system default model is "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
a conversation "Chat X" with the model override "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
the provider "bdd-provider-b" is disabled
I clear the model override of this conversation
the preview says this conversation will answer with "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" from "configured fallback"
the preview does not name "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
I confirm the change
I send the message "S1 c012"
the reply to "S1 c012" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
no outgoing request used the model "claude-5-haiku"
the answer's receipt names "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" and the origin "configured fallback"
